punchline: Jobs said "love what you do" after ten years of doing it.
thirty_sec: In his 2005 Stanford speech Jobs told graduates to love their work, but Newport notes that his young passion was Zen Buddhism, Apple began as an opportunity in a garage, and the love he describes came after about ten years of building the company.
question: Which work in front of you could you become good at within two years, even without passion yet?
